title: Meerkats Platform Structure v1 — contract for platform_heuristics/<platform>/structure.json
description: One platform's account anatomy: the hierarchy (what holds what, which settings live where), where each setting actually resolves, and the blast-radius facts (one structural cause, many entity-level symptoms) that diagnosis consults before per-entity reasoning. Either inheritance_and_blast_radius or blast_radius must be present. Keys starting with _ are mirror metadata (ci/mirror.py) and always allowed.

additionalProperties.description: one level of the account tree: holds, settings_here, notes — hand-authored facts

setting_location_rules.description: setting name -> where it actually lives / how it composes (e.g. effective bid stacking)

shared_account_assets.description: account-level objects shared across campaigns (audiences, budgets, feeds) — coupling checks

cross_refs.description: pointers to the sibling pack files and the registry
